svg.title: Your first prompt to Codebase Onboarding Agent
svg.desc: Paste a repository URL or attach source and ask for a beginner tour, architecture, startup path, setup commands and three safe first contributions.
svg.text: Copy this prompt and replace the URL

g.text: “Analyze this codebase for a beginner: [PASTE REPOSITORY URL]
Explain what it does, draw a small architecture map, find the real
entry point, explain key files and dependencies, derive safe setup
and test steps, then suggest 3 small first contributions. Separate
facts from inferences and tell me what you could not verify.”

svg.text: If the assistant can't browse the repo, upload the ZIP or the relevant source files instead.
